scientific_integrity: The asymptotic assertion is proved analytically. Finite numerical checks are supporting reproducibility, not a substitute for an infinite proof. Source version v2 specifies the tested fixed-preconditioner algorithm; v1 establishes the first public date.
scientific_limitations: Only the first update of the fixed-preconditioner, rank-two POEM-ES estimator on deterministic linear functions over a disk; no iterative rate, noisy-oracle or arbitrary-dimensional assertion. Historical priority may require a broader signed-angular minimax literature comparison.
title: Exact minimax first-step progress for ellipsoidal zeroth-order sampling
